Name: Sunrooms and Greenhouses (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
I give you 5 unique sunrooms or greenhouses for PIF in fun shapes that kind of developed through playing around in Tiled with the new tiles I made for my tilesheet. Have fun with them!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

[b]Adds the following Sunrooms/Greenhouses for PIF:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fancy Sunroom: Comes with three different house upgrade versions
[*]Growing Hall: Configurable crop fields in the left and right area (choose between field, rows and tree spots)
[*]Gable Sunroom
[*]Botanical Sunroom
[*]Ornate Sunroom
[/list]
[b]All offer these features:[/b]

[list]
[*]Seasonal backgrounds and dynamic glass that turn dark at night/when raining
[*]All tiles tillable so you are not limited to the crop fields. This also lets you plant trees and tea saplings wherever you like.
[*]Decoratable floors and walls
[*]Chance of spawning butterflies during the day and when not raining (requires MMAP, can turn off in settings)
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img]﻿

[b]Recolours[/b]: Compatible with the same recolours that my tilesheet mod is compatible with (VPR and Earthy, but you can use another recolour and pick the one that looks best without any hard clashes)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528309.png[/img]

Partly inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16405]Aimons Greenhouse[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28723]Tea conservatory [/url]and probably some other greenhouse mods that are around. Go check them out!

[b]Furniture mods used for decorating:[/b]
HxW furniture packs: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16717]Greenhouse[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35943]Florist[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36273]Flowers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27174]Plants[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28537]Door Mania[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ (highly recommended for placing wall furniture for this mod!)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528397.png[/img]

Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Personal Indoor Farm. 1.6. is required.
You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it. Check out the instructions on the PIF modpage if you don't know how it works.
